summary.text: Ed Sutton is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 20 in Charleston County.
His official page lists his occupation as real estate developer and Air Force pilot, and his committees include Judiciary and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Sutton earned a B.A. from The Citadel in 2006 and a master's degree from the Air Command and Staff College in 2014.
He served on active duty in the U.S. Air Force from 2006 to 2014 and has been in the Air Force Reserves since 2014, holding the rank of lieutenant colonel.
His page lists service as a board member of the National Medal of Honor Museum from 2015 to 2020 and of the Charleston Area Regional Transportation Authority from 2023 to 2025.
He is a board member of Leadership S.C. and president emeritus of the Reynolds Ave. Merchants Association.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Corrections and Penology, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary, and Transportation.
